title: Vacation Rental Deposit
scenario: A host asks you to leave the platform and wire the deposit.

answers.A: Wire the deposit directly to hold the property.
answers.B: Send the deposit after checking the host social profile.
answers.C: Keep the deposit and messages inside the booking platform.
answers.D: Contact platform support before sending anything off-platform.

explanation: Off-platform payment removes the platform protection and makes a fake listing harder to recover. Keep the whole transaction inside the booking system.
proTip: A real host can use the platform they listed on.
